support_ticket_text: My home internet has been extremely slow for two days and keeps disconnecting. I cannot reliably work from home.
The Wi-Fi signal is weak in the bedroom, but moving closer to the router usually lets me finish my calls.
I am locked out of my online banking account and need a password reset before an urgent payment today.
My laptop will not start after restarting it twice. I have a presentation in the morning and cannot access the files on it.
My smartphone battery drains quickly, but the phone still works and I can charge it during the day.
The laptop touchpad stops responding occasionally. I can use a USB mouse until it is repaired.
My gaming laptop shows flickering graphics during games, while browsing and office work still function normally.
The external hard drive is not recognized. I have a current backup in cloud storage, so I can keep working for now.
I deleted the only copy of my project folder by mistake. The files are needed for a client delivery tomorrow.
I accidentally formatted my USB drive with the only copy of our presentation. Please help recover it.
My computer is slower than usual but I can still complete my work. It has been happening for about a week.
My PC has crashed to a blue screen several times today and I cannot finish any work on it.
A software app freezes once or twice a day. Restarting the app fixes it and I have not lost any files.
My internet drops during video calls, but I can switch to my phone hotspot. It has happened a few times this week.
It happened again. Please fix this as soon as possible.
My laptop is very slow and some files disappeared after it crashed. I do not know if this is a software issue or a failing drive.
My phone will not turn on, although I am using it to send this message and make calls.
The router is slow and my USB drive was formatted. Please fix both problems in one ticket.
My account does not work. I need help.
The computer is sometimes slow, but only when I open one program. Everything else seems fine.
Could you suggest a recipe for vegetarian curry and tell me what groceries to buy?
Who won yesterday’s football match? I am not reporting a problem with a device or service.
Please rewrite my cover letter to sound more confident. There is no technical problem.
The laptop case has a small scratch. It works normally and the mark does not affect use.
The laptop keyboard has one sticky key. I can use an external keyboard and have no deadline.
My laptop screen went black and has not come back on. I have a deadline today and cannot access my work.
My USB drive is physically cracked and contains the only copy of a research dataset. Please do not ask me to format it.
My password reset email is delayed, but I can still sign in on my phone. Please investigate when convenient.
The internet is slow, but I can use a wired connection to finish work. Please check the router when available.
My external drive clicks and disconnects. It holds the only copy of our financial records and is needed for an audit tomorrow.
